field-workforce.metaTitle: Field Workforce Management Software & GPS Route Tracking | SpotSign AI
field-workforce.metaDescription: Track mobile field technicians, verify GPS geofenced customer check-ins, and automate travel reimbursements with SpotSign AI Field Operations.
field-workforce.whatItSolves: Lack of visibility into roaming field staff, unverified customer visit claims, manual mileage calculation disputes, and delayed job ticket completion reporting.
field-workforce.howItWorks: Field personnel check in via the mobile PWA inside designated client GPS radiuses. The system records location breadcrumbs efficiently, tracks travel distances for automated reimbursement, and credits per-visit completion milestones directly into payroll.

capabilities.title: Geofenced Client Check-In with Photo Verification
capabilities.desc: Validates staff attendance only when physically within customer site boundaries with optional storefront or meter photos.

capabilities.title: Automated Travel Distance & Mileage Reimbursement
capabilities.desc: Measures exact GPS travel distances between customer waypoints, calculating fuel allowances automatically without odometer disputes.

capabilities.title: Daily Beat & Route Sequence Optimization
capabilities.desc: Organizes daily customer visit queues to minimize transit time and maximize face-to-face client hours.

capabilities.title: Offline-Capable Job Ticket Submissions
capabilities.desc: Allows technicians to capture signatures, parts used, and work completion notes in basements or rural areas without active signal.

capabilities.title: Per-Visit & Milestone Piece-Rate Incentives
capabilities.desc: Credits variable piece-rate completion bonuses directly into monthly wage registers upon supervisor sign-off.

faqs.q: Does background GPS tracking drain the employee phone battery?
faqs.a: No. Our PWA uses event-based geofence triggers and significant-motion APIs rather than continuous high-drain satellite polling, consuming less than 4% battery per work shift.

faqs.q: Can managers assign emergency visits on the fly?
faqs.a: Yes. Dispatchers can push high-priority field service tickets to the nearest available technician with real-time route directions.

talent.title: Talent Management, Competency Frameworks, and Succession Planning
talent.subtitle: Map organizational capability benchmarks, build 9-box succession pipelines, and align internal talent mobility with future strategic workforce demand.
talent.metaTitle: Enterprise Talent Management & Succession Planning Software | SpotSign AI
talent.metaDescription: Calibrate bench strength, map employee competency matrices, and plan leadership succession with SpotSign AI Talent Management.
talent.whatItSolves: Critical leadership vacancies with zero qualified internal successors, unmeasured organizational skill deficits, and talented employees departing due to lack of transparent career paths.
talent.howItWorks: SpotSign AI maintains continuous competency graphs across all employees. Leadership visualizes organizational depth across 9-box matrices, identifies flight-risk critical talent, and stages succession readiness pipelines.

capabilities.title: 9-Box Talent Calibration Matrix
capabilities.desc: Plots employee performance review ratings against future leadership potential to identify high-potentials and retention priorities.

capabilities.title: Succession Bench Depth Pipelines
capabilities.desc: Designate Ready Now, Ready in 1 Year, and Emergency backup candidates for all critical enterprise positions.

capabilities.title: Role Competency Ladders & Skill Matrices
capabilities.desc: Defines transparent capability expectations across technical, leadership, and operational job families.

capabilities.title: Internal Talent Mobility & Project Marketplace
capabilities.desc: Matches verified employee competencies with open internal positions and cross-functional project pods.

capabilities.title: Flight-Risk Succession Safeguards
capabilities.desc: Alerts leadership when high-potential candidates in single-point-of-failure roles show early attrition signals.

faqs.q: How does succession planning connect with Workforce Planning?
faqs.a: The Workforce Planning simulation engine directly imports talent succession graphs, calculating whether proposed departmental restructures will eliminate critical leadership successors.

faqs.q: Can managers maintain private succession notes?
faqs.a: Yes. Strict role-based access controls ensure succession nominations and calibration notes remain confidential to authorized C-suite and HR leaders.
